_summary.framework_note: HWM's 10-K does not name a single Pentagon Program Element or program-of-record title — it stays at the segment-aggregate level ('defense aerospace = 19% of revenue'). The J-Book divergence pattern requires program-specific claims to test; HWM provides none. Inferred candidate PEs (F-35, V-22, B-21, KC-46) exist in the corpus but resolve to NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE because the 410-PE corpus is FY 2026 books, which do not span the 2023-01-15 cutoff. Net: framework correctly produces UNVERIFIABLE rather than false-positive RED on a company that didn't make J-Book-grounded claims to begin with.
